# Set Up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph)
```

```{r}
load("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/citation-network/Full_Network/ref_dictionary.Rdata")
load("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/citation-network/Full_Network/citing_dictionary.Rdata")
```

# Graphing

```{r}

plot_citation_network <- function(citing_dictionary, 
                                  min_cited_indegree = 5, 
                                  min_citing_indegree = 1) {
  
  # 1. Filter out missing DOIs
  df_filtered <- citing_dictionary %>% filter(!is.na(ref_id))
  
  # 2. Extract ALL edges and classify them
  citing_ids <- unique(df_filtered$citing_id)
  
  edges <- df_filtered %>%
    select(from = citing_id, to = ref_id) %>%
    mutate(edge_type = if_else(to %in% citing_ids, "internal", "bipartite"))
  
  # 3. Calculate how many citations each cited DOI receives
  citation_counts <- edges %>%
    count(to, name = "in_degree")
  
  # 4. Build the node list
  all_nodes <- unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))
  
  label_dict <- df_filtered %>%
    select(id = citing_id, label = citing_bibtex) %>%
    bind_rows(
      df_filtered %>% select(id = ref_id, label = ref_bibtex)
    ) %>%
    distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # Local seed to ensure consistent layouts without altering the global environment
  withr::local_seed(42) 
  
  nodes <- tibble(name = all_nodes) %>%
    left_join(label_dict, by = c("name" = "id")) %>%
    left_join(citation_counts, by = c("name" = "to")) %>%
    mutate(
      in_degree = replace_na(in_degree, 0),
      node_type = if_else(name %in% citing_ids, "citing", "cited"),
      
      # Opacity logic
      node_alpha = case_when(
        node_type == "citing" ~ 1.0,
        in_degree >= min_cited_indegree ~ 0.85,
        TRUE ~ 0.2
      ),
      
      x = if_else(
        node_type == "citing", 
        0, 
        2.0 + (in_degree / max(in_degree)) * 0.6 + runif(n(), -0.03, 0.03)
      ),
      
      year = as.numeric(str_extract(label, "\\d{4}"))
    ) %>%
    mutate(year = replace_na(year, median(year, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    group_by(node_type) %>%
    arrange(desc(year), label) %>%
    mutate(
      y_raw = row_number() / n(),
      y = if_else(node_type == "citing", y_raw, y_raw + runif(n(), -0.02, 0.02))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # 5. Build the tidygraph object
  citation_graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, directed = TRUE)
  
  # 6. Plot the graph
  p <- ggraph(citation_graph, layout = "manual", x = x, y = y) +
    
    # A. Bipartite edges (Made much thinner)
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(filter = edge_type == "bipartite"),
      alpha = 0.15, 
      color = "gray70",
      edge_width = 0.1, # <--- Reduced thickness for less overlap
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.0, 'mm'), type = "closed"), # <--- Slightly smaller arrowhead
      end_cap = circle(2, 'mm')
    ) +
    
    # B. Internal edges 
    geom_edge_arc(
      aes(filter = edge_type == "internal"),
      color = "darkorchid", 
      edge_width = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.8,
      strength = 0.7, 
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(2, 'mm'), type = "closed"),
      start_cap = circle(4, 'mm'), 
      end_cap = circle(5, 'mm')    
    ) +
    
    # C. Cited DOIs (Right side) - Points & Labels
    geom_node_point(
      aes(filter = node_type == "cited", size = in_degree, color = in_degree, alpha = node_alpha)
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(filter = node_type == "cited" & in_degree >= min_cited_indegree, label = label),
      repel = TRUE,
      size = 3.5,
      color = "black",
      bg.color = "white",
      bg.r = 0.15
    ) +
    
    # D. Citing DOIs (Left side) - Points & Labels
    geom_node_point(
      aes(filter = node_type == "citing"),
      size = 2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(filter = node_type == "citing" & in_degree >= min_citing_indegree, label = label),
      repel = TRUE, # Applies the same clean avoidance algorithm as the right side
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      bg.color = "white",
      bg.r = 0.15
    ) +
    
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("dodgerblue", "cyan", "gold", "firebrick")) +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10)) +
    
    # Expanded left margin slightly to accommodate the new repelled labels on the citing side
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.4, 0.4))) +
    
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
plot_citation_network(citing_dictionary = citing_dictionary,
                      min_cited_indegree = 25,
                      min_citing_indegree = 5)
```

```{r}
plot_citation_network(citing_dictionary = citing_dictionary%>%
                        filter(citing_id %in% claims_reduced$citing_id &
                                 ref_id %in% claims_reduced$ref_id),
                      min_cited_indegree = 2,
                      min_citing_indegree = 0)
```
